name: MAC Mobility | IRB + Seamless-Integration Rejection
status_note: G2 wired 2026-04-19 via PR-G2: commit_check_assert handler in mac_mobility_orchestrator.py routes the 3 trigger verbs through a candidate-only commit-check + rollback-0 flow. DNOS syntax was live-validated on PE-1 (DNOS 26.2.0): correct keywords are 'router-interface irbN' (NOT 'irb interface'). The rejection error captured live: 'EVPN router-interface (IRB) and Seamless VPLS (EVPN seamless-integration) cannot be configured at the same time.'
gap_rationale: SW-204115 epic states: 'IRB Not Allowed to be configured with Seamless -> Test config changes.' Validates that the CLI rejects EVPN router-interface (IRB) when seamless-integration is enabled, and vice-versa. This is a critical config guard.

device_requirements.notes: No traffic needed. Pure config-validation test. Reuses any existing EVPN instance with seamless-integration as the SI fixture and any non-SI instance as the negative-control fixture.

prerequisites.fix_config: Manual: ensure an EVPN instance with seamless-integration exists on DUT (e.g. HA_TEST_ELAN on PE-1).

prerequisites.pass_criteria: Instance {non_si_instance_name} present and does NOT contain 'seamless-integration'
prerequisites.fix_config: Manual: ensure a no-SI EVPN instance exists on DUT (e.g. test_irb_reject on PE-1).

show_commands_validated.show config network-services evpn instan: Verify SI instance fixture is intact
Verify non-SI instance fixture is intact

scenarios.name: router-interface (IRB) on SI-enabled instance -> commit check must REJECT
scenarios.what_happens: Add a router-interface (IRB) binding to an EVPN instance that already has seamless-integration enabled. DNOS commit-check must reject with 'cannot be configured at the same time'. Rollback 0 always.
scenarios.what_cannot_happen: Commit-check must NOT pass. If both IRB and SI coexist successfully in the candidate, this is a BUG.

show_commands: show config network-services evpn instance {si_instance_name} | no-more

expected_error_regex: cannot be configured at the same time

expected_error_patterns: cannot be configured at the same time

show_commands: show config network-services evpn instance {si_instance_name} | no-more

scenarios.name: seamless-integration on instance with router-interface (IRB) -> commit check must REJECT
scenarios.what_happens: Bind router-interface to a NON-SI instance, then attempt to add seamless-integration. Commit-check must reject the combined candidate. Rollback 0 always.
scenarios.what_cannot_happen: Both IRB and SI must not coexist in the candidate.

expected_error_regex: cannot be configured at the same time

expected_error_patterns: cannot be configured at the same time

scenarios.name: router-interface (IRB) on a fresh non-SI instance -> commit check must SUCCEED
scenarios.what_happens: Positive control: add router-interface (IRB) to a non-SI instance (no seamless-integration). Commit-check must pass. Rollback 0 always (we never commit during validation).
scenarios.what_cannot_happen: Commit-check must not fail. If it does, IRB is broken beyond the SI guard.

cleanup.description: No cleanup needed: commit_check_assert always rolls back the candidate. Nothing was committed.

si_instance_name.fallback_from: show config network-services evpn | grep -B0 seamless-integration

non_si_instance_name.fallback_from: show config network-services evpn | grep instance

test_irb_name.notes: DNOS 26.2 IRB form is 'irbN' (no dash). Live-validated on PE-1 2026-04-19.
